Term.Name: Leanback
Term.Definition: A device such as a television or set-top box typically using a remote control for interaction, relying on up, down, left, right directional arrow, OK, and back key events input and for navigation.

Term.Name: Mobile
Term.Definition: A handheld device such as a smartphone typically using a smaller portrait-oriented touchscreen for input and navigation.

Term.Name: Tablet
Term.Definition: A device typicaly using a larger touchscreen for input and navigation.

Term.Name: Automotive
Term.Definition: A device integrated into a vehicule, typically using a touchscreen, steering wheel buttons and voice, for input and navigation.
